description: raw-recurrence-v5 with QAT inside the stages (owner 2026-10-10): the shared quantization component (precision points q4, ternary-experts, ternary over curriculum progress, ramps sized from conversion v3's trend; train/quantization.py) and the conservative backbone rate 7.5e-6 (Pop's full-backbone drift at 3e-5, coord pop-f309/8133). Evaluations and full-state writes only at step-declared points (owner 2026-10-10), sized from measured Mellum step times: about 16 evenly spaced evaluation points per stage, the last at the stage end (its gate); full-state writes about every 3 h at a subset of them, plus the stage end and stops (full state within the memory ledger's stop grace). The best is the best among those writes (a hard link). Shared by every line. History: recipes/HISTORY.md.

quantization.description: QAT woven into the stages (owner 2026-10-10, plans/neuralese/DECISIONS.md 'QAT inside every training stage'): a ladder of precision points over curriculum progress, the multi-precision objective sampled per update, BF16 the teacher. Experts (and dense FFN) first, attention later; full ternary reported, not required. Ternary uses Maple's per-row rule as conversion v3 and the TQ2_0 export do. Ramp lengths from v3's trend (held lambda=1 KL 10.0, 6.2, 4.5, 5.3, 4.5, 4.0 and agreement 0.03 to 0.35 over its first 500 updates while lambda reached ~0.42): ternary needs thousands of updates, so each ternary ramp spans ~40% of the curriculum (~2,900 of ~7,200 updates).
